scripts.build: node scripts/optimise-brand-images.mjs && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/admin-tools.mjs manifest
scripts.dev:worker: cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH=.wrangler/registry wrangler dev --env local --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 5181

scripts.db:remote:init: cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler d1 migrations apply sesonal-admin --remote && node scripts/admin-tools.mjs seed && cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler d1 execute sesonal-admin --remote --file .wrangler/tools/seed.sql
scripts.preview:worker: cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH=.wrangler/registry wrangler dev --env local --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 5181
